study_title: Path-Robust Risk Controls for Intraday Mean Reversion in NSE Equities
purpose: Evaluate the existing chronological validation partition and strengthen reproducibility without changing the strategy after seeing validation outcomes.
strategy_changes: None: retain the submitted signal, fixed parameters, three matched exit policies, two timestamp interpretations, two candle paths and seven execution settings.
primary_comparison: Combined minus time-only mean daily P&L divided by fixed reference capital, on common evaluable session-reset dates, under reference execution and O-L-H-C ordering; report both unconfirmed timestamp interpretations.
secondary_measures: descriptive ES97.5 with effective tail mass
declared cost, stop-slippage and delay sensitivities
new_software_checks: independent reconciliation of exported trade and cash ledgers
inference: All nominal moving-block intervals remain exploratory. Retain the existing segment-support rule; do not change block length or exclude dates to obtain significance.
final_stage: Disabled in the interim M6 notebook. No final strategy outcomes or protocol freeze will be generated in this development pass.
